_about: The team's trained detector (cam_control/models/warehouse_yolo26.pt on branch multiview, 7 classes) for the car's own camera. Copy to detector.json next to vlm_grab.py to make the grab use it instead of the laptop VLM; delete detector.json to go back to the VLM.
_model: yolo export model=warehouse_yolo26.pt format=onnx imgsz=416 opset=12 end2end=False  (class names travel inside the .onnx)
_classes: bracket, knob, slotted_block, cup, holder, stand, block. A name like 'red block' matches the class 'block'; the model does not know colours.
_conf: photos from the cars, 2026-11-14: real blocks 0.70-0.92, false boxes (the gripper's red tips, a carpet stripe) at most 0.45
_debris: WHITELIST of detector classes that count as debris to clear (seek detector 'yolo'); read again at every search, so a change on a car takes effect at once. 2026-11-15: all 7 classes (user: not only blocks). Safety in seek.nearest_object: an uncoloured thing must score >= 0.75 and must not touch the picture's edge, so the white marker cups and grey wall panels are not taken.
